2 weeks ago - Dead Oceans, Inc., is an American independent record label founded in 2006 and based in Bloomington, Indiana. It operates as part of the Secretly Group, alongside Secretly Canadian and Jagjaguwar. On June 30, 2006, Phil Waldorf founded Dead Oceans with Chris Swanson.
